summary: Petition under Section 62 read with Section 79(1)(d) of the Electricity Act, 2003 and under Regulations 15(1)(a) and 23 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2023 read with the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2019 for determination cum truing up of the transmission tariff for the 2019-24 period and under the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2024 for determination of the transmission tariff for the 2024- 29 period for the assets under North Eastern Region Strengthening Scheme XII. **4. Power and Electricity Department,** Government of Mizoram, Aizawl. (Mizoram). - _a) “Approve the determination cum trued-up Transmission Tariff for 2019-24 block and transmission tariff for 2024-29 block for the assets covered under this petition, as per para 24 and 25 above._ - b) _Admit the capital cost claimed and additional capitalization incurred during 2019-24 and also allow the projected additional capitalization during 2024-29._ - e) _Allow the petitioner to recover the shortfall or refund the excess Annual Fixed Charges, on account of Return on Equity due to change in applicable Minimum Alternate/Corporate Income Tax rate as per the Income Tax Act, 1961 (as amended from time to time) of the respective financial year directly without making any application before the Commission as provided in Tariff Regulations, 2019 and Tariff Regulations, 2024 as per para 24 & 25 above for respective block._ - f) _Approve the reimbursement of expenditure by the beneficiaries towards petition filing fee, and expenditure on publishing of notices in newspapers in terms of 70(1) Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2019 and Regulation 94 (1) Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2024, and other expenditure (if any) in relation to the filing of petition._ - g) _Allow the petitioner to bill and recover RLDC fees & charges and Licensee fee, separately from the respondents in terms of Regulation 70 (3) and (4) Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2024 and Regulation 94 (3) and (4) Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2024._ - h) _Allow the petitioner to bill and adjust impact on Interest on Loan due to change in Interest rate on account of floating rate of interest applicable during 201924 and 2024-29 period, if any, from the respondents._ - j) _Allow the petitioner to file a separate petition before the Commission for claiming the overall security expenses and consequential IOWC on that security expenses as mentioned at para 31 above._ - k) _Allow the petitioner to file a separate petition before the Commission for claiming the overall insurance expenses and consequential IOWC on that insurance expenses as mentioned at para 31 above._ - l) _Allow the petitioner to file a separate petition before the Commission for claiming the overall capital spares at the end of tariff block as per actual as mentioned at Para 31 above._ - m) _Allow the petitioner to claim expenses of CTUIL borne by POWERGRID through a separate petition on year to year/ at the end of tariff block as mentioned at para 32 above._ - n) _Allow the Petitioner to bill and recover GST on Transmission Charges separately from the respondents, if GST on transmission is levied at any rate in future. Further, any taxes including GST and duties including cess, etc. imposed by any statutory/Govt./municipal authorities shall be allowed to be recovered from the beneficiaries._ - _o) Condone the delay in completion of subject assets on merit of the same beyond the control of Petitioner in line with CERC Regulations, 2019 22(2) “uncontrollable factors” and approve the tariff as claimed._ _and pass such other relief as the Commission deems fit and appropriate under the circumstances of the case and in the interest of justice.”_ 3. During the hearing on 22.4.2026, the Petitioner's representative submitted that the cost claimed for the reconductoring works in the present Petition had already been claimed as Additional Capital Expenditure (ACE) under the original projects in Petition No. 529/TT/2025 (Chukha Transmission System) and Petition No. 509/TT/2025 (Transmission System associated with Loktak HEP). Accordingly, sought permission to withdraw the instant Petition. 4. We have considered the Petitioner’s submissions and perused the record. It is noted that the Commission, vide order dated 25.10.2024 in Petition No. 94/TT/2024, observed that the capital expenditure incurred for re-conductoring shall be claimed as Additional Capitalisation under the transmission system where the original transmission line was initially approved. 5. In instant case, the Petitioner, by its affidavits dated 18.2.2026 and 13.5.2026, has submitted that the original transmission lines relating to the transmission assets in this case were covered in two Petitions, namely (i) Petition No. 529/TT/2025 (Chukha Transmission System) and (ii) Petition No. 509/TT/2025 (Transmission System associated with Loktak HEP), in which the costs of the reconductoring works have already been claimed as Additional Capitalisation under the respective original projects. Accordingly, the Petitioner prayed for the withdrawal of this Petition. 6. Considering the submissions made by the Petitioner`s representative, the Petitioner is permitted to withdraw this Petition.
title: Petition under Section 62 read with Section 79(1)(d) of the Electricity Act, 2003 and under Regulations 15(1)(a) and 23 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2023 read with the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2019 for determination cum truing up of the transmission tariff for the 2019-24 period and under the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2024 for determination of the transmission tariff for the 2024- 29 period for the assets under North Eastern Region Strengthening Scheme XII.
